title: How much sensor data is available?
population: Nonpregnant people with type 1 or type 2 diabetes using CGM
finding: The ADA lists 14 days of CGM wear and 70% active data over that window as a benchmark for pattern assessment.
limitations: This is a benchmark for interpreting patterns. Missing time and periods with selective use can affect interpretation.
design_implication: Show observed coverage and date window alongside any CGM summary. Keep sparse periods visible.

title: What do my meter checks cover?
evidence: ADA 2026 technology guideline and product inference
finding: Finger-stick checks are individual observations. Their timing can depend on meals, activity, symptoms and other circumstances.
limitations: A set of checks samples specific moments. It does not measure how long glucose was in range between the checks.
design_implication: Show fraction of checks in range, sample counts and times. Reserve time in range for supported sensor data.

title: Why lab A1C and glucose summaries can differ
population: People comparing A1C and glucose records
finding: Some conditions, including those that affect red blood cell turnover, can alter the relationship between A1C and glucose.
limitations: The app cannot identify the reason for a difference from these records alone.
design_implication: Keep lab A1C distinct from a CGM-derived indicator. Show data source and observation dates.

title: Glucose goals can change with health circumstances
finding: The ADA recommends individualizing goals for older adults and prioritizing avoidance of hypoglycemia.
limitations: Individual circumstances matter. An app cannot infer a person's appropriate goal from age or readings alone.
design_implication: Store user-entered care-team targets with effective dates and preserve the settings used for a past report.

title: Dexcom G7 data in Apple Health can arrive later
population: U.S. Dexcom G7 and G7 15 Day users sharing through Apple Health
finding: Dexcom documents a three-hour delay for this route into Apple Health.
limitations: Applies to this vendor and route. Other combinations may have different timing.
design_implication: Show measured-at and received-at separately. Preserve device and route on each reading.

title: Where device alerts come from
finding: The FDA received reports of missed or inaudible safety alerts after phone hardware, software or settings changes.
limitations: Safety reports establish a design concern and do not provide the frequency for a particular phone or app.
design_implication: Keep diary reminders distinct from device alarms. Identify the device app responsible for its own alarms.

title: Finding diabetes education and support
population: People seeking diabetes education in the U.S.
finding: Costs, referral gaps, and limited local services can affect participation in diabetes self-management education and support.
design_implication: Offer access resources without an account. Let users add a question or barrier to their visit notes.

title: Help paying for diabetes care
population: People looking for U.S. diabetes-care assistance
finding: NIDDK points to insurance and financial assistance resources for diabetes care.
limitations: Eligibility and coverage depend on the program and location. Check current terms directly.
design_implication: Put the resource next to refill tracking. Record verification dates and keep links optional.

title: Keep the school care plan handy
finding: The school guide describes using an individualized Diabetes Medical Management Plan and planning for emergencies.
limitations: The student's own care team's instructions and the school's processes govern the actual plan.
design_implication: Keep a versioned copy available offline and let families explicitly choose what to share.

title: What diabetes app studies can tell us
population: People enrolled in diabetes self-management app trials
evidence: 2024 systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized trials
finding: The review identified associations between self-monitoring or medication-taking features and better glycemic outcomes across included trials.
limitations: Interventions differed. Feature-level associations do not establish which feature caused an effect or how this tracker will perform.
design_implication: Prioritize easy logging and medication history. Evaluate task errors and burden before claiming clinical benefit.

title: Sensor trial in adults using basal insulin
population: Adults with type 2 diabetes using basal insulin without prandial insulin in the MOBILE trial
finding: The trial reported greater A1C improvement with CGM than with a blood glucose meter in its study group.
limitations: The intervention was CGM, and results may not generalize to other populations or a diary app.
design_implication: Support sensor imports where verified while maintaining a complete meter workflow.

title: Sensor trial during pregnancy with type 1 diabetes
population: Pregnant participants with type 1 diabetes on intensive insulin therapy in CONCEPTT
finding: The pregnancy trial reported improved neonatal outcomes with CGM use alongside capillary glucose monitoring.
limitations: The study population and intervention do not establish outcomes for gestational diabetes or for this app.
design_implication: Support a separate pregnancy report layout with the person's saved clinician targets.

title: Sensor studies across different diabetes populations
population: People with type 1, type 2, or diabetes during pregnancy in the included trials
evidence: 2025 systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized trials
finding: The review synthesizes CGM trial evidence across several diabetes populations.
limitations: Compare population, device type, comparator and outcomes before applying a result to an app workflow.
design_implication: Track populations separately in the research catalog and report design decisions against the relevant population.

title: Long-term outcomes in type 1 diabetes
population: Participants with type 1 diabetes in the DCCT
finding: The 1993 trial linked intensive treatment to lower risk of several microvascular complications, with more severe hypoglycemia.
limitations: A historical treatment trial cannot establish the effect of this tracker or select a personal target.
design_implication: Support multi-year history and dated lab results while retaining care-team ownership of treatment.

title: Long-term outcomes in type 2 diabetes
population: Participants with newly diagnosed type 2 diabetes in UKPDS 33
finding: The 1998 trial reported reduced microvascular complications with intensive glucose control.
limitations: The study tested specific management strategies in its era. Its outcomes do not establish the effect of an app.
design_implication: Support multi-year history and dated lab results while retaining care-team ownership of treatment.
